name: John Deere Davenport Works - Davenport IA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Site is set ~600 m back from the public road across landscaped grounds, reached by a wide private internal access road off a controlled intersection on E 90th St. Multi-lane markings at the road junction indicate a controlled private entry. No Street View coverage on the internal road and no booth resolved in satellite, so a perimeter control point is inferred from the campus layout.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth resolved at the public-road entry or along the access road in available imagery; large Deere assembly campuses of this era typically use a check-in point near the building rather than a road booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true as the corollary of an inferred gate with no resolved booth; low confidence.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Five distinct building masses on the campus: the giant main assembly hall plus older north/NE building sections and outbuildings.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Two major yard zones: trailer rows and material storage on the NE, plus a long finished-equipment marshaling apron (graders, articulated dump trucks, wheel loaders) along the north building face.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~20 estimated truck dock positions along the north building face; finished construction equipment also ships drive-away / on flatbeds, so dock count understates throughput.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~290 acres for the fenced industrial parcel; surrounding farmland excluded.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural — large standalone plant in open farmland NE of Davenport near the Hwy 130 / I-80 area.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Enormous paved aprons and wide internal roads leave abundant room for added or express truck lanes.
